title: Analysis fact artifact v1
description: Content of a result artifact whose manifest media type is application/vnd.socalytics.facts+json. It carries the header of the producing capability and a list of time-ranged facts in match time. The platform validates the envelope only; the payload of each fact is owned by the capability and opaque to the platform. The artifact contains no URLs, credentials, or inline media.

fact.description: One fact with a half-open match-time range [startMs, endMs). The platform additionally checks endMs > startMs.

payload.description: Capability-owned content, opaque to the platform.
